rec.name: Before vs. After Image Compare Slider
rec.status: Built — launched to live theme (section hidden pending customer feedback)

what.text: A reusable theme section with a draggable before/after (compare) slider. Two images of the same product (e.g. the same bag with two different flaps) sit on top of each other and a vertical handle reveals one or the other as the visitor drags it. A subheading and heading (with an underlined accent word) sit above the image. Each compare item has its own short caption (Lorem / Lorem ipsum) at the bottom-left and bottom-right. Reference designs: the ZOE LU advertorial, which combines the slider with a headline, star rating, benefit checklist and CTA button, and Wind & Vibes, which shows labelled variants (e.g. 'Manhattan Black & Tweed Buckle' vs 'Manhattan Black & Teddy White') under the heading 'One bag - different styles'.

why.text: Interactive comparison turns passive scrolling into engagement and lets shoppers see product variants or interchangeable parts side by side without leaving the page. This makes the value of the modular or 2-for-1 offer tangible, reduces choice paralysis ('classy or unique?') and reduces uncertainty about what they will get. Dragging the handle creates a small commitment and curiosity loop that increases time on page and intent to click the CTA.

how.text: Built as a custom Shopify section (originally requested via Sectionfy.io) with custom JavaScript for the compare effect. Add the section 'CRO | Before vs After' in the theme editor. Fill in the Subheading and Heading blocks, then add two 'Compare Item' blocks (image plus caption each). Set heights per device, image style (Cover/Contain), corner radius, text and button colors, font sizes and fonts, and section width (Container/Full). Use the max-width setting to shrink the section on desktop (e.g. 950px). Because the store hit the theme limit, it was added directly to the live theme and hidden until approved.

items: Custom font-family toggle and font selection (Inter / Inter Bold)
Max-width setting for narrower desktop display (e.g. 950px)
Blocks: Subheading, Heading, 2x Compare Item (image + caption)

dependencies.text: Custom section code with custom JavaScript for the compare slider (built with Sectionfy.io per the request). Theme: Focal 8.8.1 (zoelu-focal/main). No metafields or apps needed beyond that. A variant with 2 text columns plus slider (as in the ZOE LU advertorial) was requested but not built — it would need a separate ticket and a check that the slider scripts work together.

items: Add-to-cart rate / conversion rate on the test page
Scroll depth and time on page
AOV (when used to promote 2-for-1 or flap sets)
